text: The status of the 2021 tree-cover loss on the property is supported. Approximately 81.3 hectares of tree-cover loss were mapped within the asset in 2021, which is about 2.23% of the total area. This loss was corroborated by observing a later year and agreeing with the JRC 2020 reference on 98% of the event area. The forest type over the event area was primarily planted forest, specifically Pinus elliottii and Pinus taeda. Additionally, there were losses in patches under 0.5 hectares in 2021 that were not counted as an event.
